+@prefix proto: <urn:ref:research:shacl-sparql#> .
+@prefix rdf:   <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
+@prefix sh:    <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
+@prefix skos:  <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
+@prefix rkaf:  <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .
+
+# Prototype compiler output for the four cross-record rules in
+# bindings/atlas/3.1/tools/validate.py::_check_machine_adjudication.
+# Every query uses only SPARQL 1.1 and SHACL-SPARQL pre-bound $this.
+
+proto:FiveAxisIndependenceShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "A satisfied comparison must cite a proof pair that differs by actor, independence group, provider, model ID, and response artifact." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this rkaf:comparisonOutcome rkaf:comparisonSatisfied .
+        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
+          $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?leftProof, ?rightProof .
+          FILTER(?leftProof != ?rightProof)
+
+          ?leftProof
+            rkaf:proofIssuer ?leftIssuer ;
+            rkaf:independenceGroup ?leftGroup ;
+            rkaf:hasAILineage ?leftLineage ;
+            rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?leftResponse .
+          ?rightProof
+            rkaf:proofIssuer ?rightIssuer ;
+            rkaf:independenceGroup ?rightGroup ;
+            rkaf:hasAILineage ?rightLineage ;
+            rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?rightResponse .
+          ?leftIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?leftProvider .
+          ?rightIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?rightProvider .
+          ?leftLineage rkaf:modelId ?leftModel .
+          ?rightLineage rkaf:modelId ?rightModel .
+
+          FILTER(
+            ?leftIssuer != ?rightIssuer &&
+            ?leftGroup != ?rightGroup &&
+            ?leftProvider != ?rightProvider &&
+            STR(?leftModel) != STR(?rightModel) &&
+            ?leftResponse != ?rightResponse
+          )
+        }
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:CompleteSupportShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:ResolverProofRecord ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "The comparison for which a proof was issued must cite that proof." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this rkaf:proofComparisonContext ?comparison .
+        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
+          ?comparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        }
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:VerdictLatticeFoldShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "The complete cited verdict set must fold onto the mapping relation stated by the expected assertion." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
+      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this
+          rkaf:comparisonOutcome rkaf:comparisonSatisfied ;
+          rkaf:comparisonExpectedAssertion ?assertion ;
+          rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?proof .
+        ?assertion rdf:predicate ?statedRelation .
+        ?proof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?verdict .
+
+        FILTER(
+          !(
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:exactMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badExactProof .
+                ?badExactProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badExactVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badExactVerdict != rkaf:verdictSame)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:closeMatch &&
+              EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?nearProof .
+                ?nearProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict rkaf:verdictNearSame .
+              } &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badCloseProof .
+                ?badCloseProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badCloseVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badCloseVerdict NOT IN (
+                  rkaf:verdictSame,
+                  rkaf:verdictNearSame
+                ))
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:broadMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badBroadProof .
+                ?badBroadProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badBroadVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badBroadVerdict != rkaf:verdictTargetBroader)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:narrowMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badNarrowProof .
+                ?badNarrowProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badNarrowVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badNarrowVerdict != rkaf:verdictTargetNarrower)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:relatedMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badRelatedProof .
+                ?badRelatedProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badRelatedVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badRelatedVerdict != rkaf:verdictRelated)
+              }
+            )
+          )
+        )
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:ProofReplayRefusalShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:ResolverProofRecord ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "A proof record may be cited by only one comparison." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT $this
+      WHERE {
+        ?firstComparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        ?secondComparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        FILTER(?firstComparison != ?secondComparison)
+      }
+      """
+  ] .

exec

   434	# atlas:verdictRelation lost "unrelated" and "insufficient_evidence" on the way
   435	# here: a verdict names a RELATION, and those two name a refusal, which is a
   436	# #ResolverProofOutcome (rkaf:gateFail / rkaf:gateUnknown). See the machine-
   437	# adjudication block in ontology/atlas.ttl.
   438	MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_VERDICTS = frozenset(
   439	    {
   440	        RKAF.verdictSame,
   441	        RKAF.verdictNearSame,
   442	        RKAF.verdictTargetBroader,
   443	        RKAF.verdictTargetNarrower,
   444	        RKAF.verdictRelated,
   445	    }
   446	)
   447	# The five independence axes, each named by how it is reached from one proof
   448	# record. Two proofs are independent witnesses of one sealed question only when
   449	# they differ on ALL five: distinct actors, groups, providers, and model IDs
   450	# still describe one witnessed answer if that answer is the identical sealed
   451	# response artifact (rulespec spec/rkaf-refspec.md, corrected 2026-08-09;
   452	# rkaf:MachineAdjudicationIndependentPairShape).
   453	# The three #GateStatus values a machine adjudication may return. Published,
   454	# never pinned: a consumer that cannot tell "never adjudicated" from
   455	# "adjudicated and refused" has lost the distinction rulespec keeps an outcome
   456	# enum to preserve. Only rkaf:gatePass proofs can license a mapping.
   457	MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_OUTCOMES = frozenset(
   458	    {RKAF.gatePass, RKAF.gateFail, RKAF.gateUnknown}
   459	)
   460	# rkaf's #RelationComparisonOutcome, all five. Only rkaf:comparisonSatisfied
   461	# licenses; the other four are the audit record of a comparison that was run
   462	# and did not.
   463	RELATION_COMPARISON_OUTCOMES = frozenset(
   464	    {
   465	        RKAF.comparisonSatisfied,
   466	        RKAF.comparisonAffirmedDeniedDiscrepancy,
   467	        RKAF.comparisonConflict,
   468	        RKAF.comparisonNotComparable,
   469	        RKAF.comparisonUnknown,
   470	    }
   471	)
   472	MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_INDEPENDENCE_AXES = (
   473	    "validator actor",
   474	    "independence group",
   475	    "provider",
   476	    "provider model id",
   477	    "response artifact",
   478	)
   479	# The four independent Rulespec axes that atlas:reviewMethod used to conflate
   480	# into one six-value enum, plus the attestor kind. Rulespec keeps them apart on
   481	# purpose: #EvidenceRole's comment says the split "prevents a consumer from
   482	# treating retrieval evidence as authority evidence merely because both point
   483	# at the same fragment", and #EpistemicBasis is "deliberately independent of
   484	# rkaf:assertionOrigin, which records what CONSTRUCTED the record".
   485	#
  4710	    )
  4711	    if missing is not None:
  4712	        _fail("dataset.evidence", f"assertion has no immutable evidence binding: {missing}")
  4713	
  4714	
  4715	def _adjudicated_relation(verdicts: AbstractSet[URIRef]) -> URIRef | None:
  4716	    """Fold a complete verdict set onto the one relation it licenses, if any.
  4717	
  4718	    The lattice is UNIVERSAL, not existential: it folds *every* verdict cited
  4719	    for one sealed question, so a third machine cannot outvote a direction
  4720	    disagreement and a set mixing ``verdictNearSame`` with a directional
  4721	    verdict licenses nothing. A mapping is emitted at the weakest claim any
  4722	    machine made, which is why ``same`` together with ``nearSame`` yields
  4723	    ``skos:closeMatch`` -- one machine declined to claim identity, and
  4724	    ``skos:exactMatch`` is the only mapping relation whose transitivity this
  4725	    binding lets a consumer rely on (``_check_reasoning_isolation``).
  4726	
  4727	    Ported verbatim from ``src/refspec/atlas/model.py``'s qualification-path
  4728	    lattice, with rkaf's verdict IRIs in place of v1's seven literals; the two
  4729	    values rkaf drops are refusals rather than relations and never reach a
  4730	    verdict slot at all (see ontology/atlas.ttl).
  4731	    """
  4732	
  4733	    if not verdicts:
  4734	        return None
  4735	    if verdicts == {RKAF.verdictSame}:
  4736	        return SKOS.exactMatch
  4737	    if verdicts <= {RKAF.verdictSame, RKAF.verdictNearSame}:
  4738	        return SKOS.closeMatch
  4739	    if verdicts == {RKAF.verdictTargetBroader}:
  4740	        return SKOS.broadMatch
  4741	    if verdicts == {RKAF.verdictTargetNarrower}:
  4742	        return SKOS.narrowMatch
  4743	    if verdicts == {RKAF.verdictRelated}:
  4744	        return SKOS.relatedMatch
  4745	    return None
  4746	
  4747	
  4748	def _machine_adjudication_artifact_facts(
  4749	    asserted: Graph,
  4750	    artifacts: AbstractSet[URIRef],
  4751	) -> dict[URIRef, dict[str, Any]]:
  4752	    """Resolve every bundled artifact to its identifiers and its exact bytes."""
  4753	
  4754	    facts: dict[URIRef, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  4755	    for artifact in sorted(artifacts):
  4756	        facts[artifact] = {
  4757	            "identifiers": frozenset(
  4758	                _literal_text(
  4759	                    value,
  4760	                    code="dataset.adjudication-input",
  4761	                    label="hasArtifactIdentifier",
  4762	                )
  4763	                for value in asserted.objects(artifact, RKAF.hasArtifactIdentifier)
  4764	            ),
  4765	            "digest": _literal_text(
  4766	                _one(asserted, artifact, RKAF.hasContentDigest, code="dataset.adjudication-input"),
  4767	                code="dataset.adjudication-input",
  4768	                label="hasContentDigest",
  4769	            ),
  4770	        }
  4771	    return facts
  4772	
  4773	
  4774	def _machine_adjudication_proof_facts(
  4775	    asserted: Graph,
  4776	    proof: URIRef,
  4777	    *,
  4778	    issuers: AbstractSet[URIRef],
  4779	    lineages: AbstractSet[URIRef],
  4780	    comparisons: AbstractSet[URIRef],
  4781	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  4782	    """Resolve one proof record, including both dereferenced axes."""
  4783	
  4784	    stored_digest = _literal_text(
  4785	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofRecordDigest, code="dataset.adjudication-identity"),
  4786	        code="dataset.adjudication-identity",
  4787	        label="proofRecordDigest",
  4788	    )
  4789	    if stored_digest != rdf_node_digest(asserted, proof):
  4790	        _fail("dataset.adjudication-identity", f"{proof} proofRecordDigest differs")
  4791	    issuer = _iri(
  4792	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofIssuer, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4793	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4794	        label="proofIssuer",
  4795	    )
  4796	    if issuer not in issuers:
  4797	        _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{proof} names unknown proof issuer {issuer}")
  4798	    lineage = _iri(
  4799	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.hasAILineage, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4800	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4801	        label="hasAILineage",
  4802	    )
  4803	    if lineage not in lineages:
  4804	        _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{proof} names unknown AI lineage {lineage}")
  4805	    comparison = _iri(
  4806	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofComparisonContext, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4807	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4808	        label="proofComparisonContext",
  4809	    )
  4810	    if comparison not in comparisons:
  4811	        _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{proof} names unknown comparison {comparison}")
  4812	    _date_time(
  4813	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofEvaluatedAt, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4814	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4815	        label="proofEvaluatedAt",
  4816	    )
  4817	    verdict = _iri(
  4818	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.adjudicationVerdict, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4819	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4820	        label="adjudicationVerdict",
  4821	    )
  4822	    if verdict not in MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_VERDICTS:
  4823	        _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{proof} states an unsupported verdict {verdict}")
  4824	    outcome = _iri(
  4825	        _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofOutcome, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4826	        code="dataset.adjudication",
  4827	        label="proofOutcome",
  4828	    )
  4829	    if outcome not in MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_OUTCOMES:
  4830	        _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{proof} states an unsupported gate status {outcome}")
  4831	    return {
  4832	        "comparison": comparison,
  4833	        "verdict": verdict,
  4834	        "outcome": outcome,
  4835	        "snapshot": _literal_text(
  4836	            _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.proofSnapshot, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4837	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  4838	            label="proofSnapshot",
  4839	        ),
  4840	        "sealedRequestDigest": _literal_text(
  4841	            _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.sealedRequestDigest, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4842	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  4843	            label="sealedRequestDigest",
  4844	        ),
  4845	        "inputContextHash": _literal_text(
  4846	            _one(asserted, lineage, RKAF.inputContextHash, code="dataset.adjudication-input"),
  4847	            code="dataset.adjudication-input",
  4848	            label="inputContextHash",
  4849	        ),
  4850	        # The five independence axes, in the order
  4851	        # MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_INDEPENDENCE_AXES names them. Two of the five are
  4852	        # reached through a referenced record rather than read off the proof, so
  4853	        # a resolver upgrade or a model swap changes one node instead of every
  4854	        # proof that cites it.
  4855	        "axes": (
  4856	            issuer,
  4857	            _iri(
  4858	                _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.independenceGroup, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4859	                code="dataset.adjudication",
  4860	                label="independenceGroup",
  4861	            ),
  4862	            _iri(
  4863	                _one(asserted, issuer, RKAF.proofResolver, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4864	                code="dataset.adjudication",
  4865	                label="proofResolver",
  4866	            ),
  4867	            _literal_text(
  4868	                _one(asserted, lineage, RKAF.modelId, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4869	                code="dataset.adjudication",
  4870	                label="modelId",
  4871	            ),
  4872	            _iri(
  4873	                _one(asserted, proof, RKAF.sealedResponseArtifact, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4874	                code="dataset.adjudication",
  4875	                label="sealedResponseArtifact",
  4876	            ),
  4877	        ),
  4878	        "inputs": frozenset(asserted.objects(proof, RKAF.proofInput)),
  4879	        "inputDigests": frozenset(
  4880	            _literal_text(value, code="dataset.adjudication-input", label="proofInputDigest")
  4881	            for value in asserted.objects(proof, RKAF.proofInputDigest)
  4882	        ),
  4883	    }
  4884	
  4885	
  4886	def _check_machine_adjudication(
  4887	    asserted: Graph,
  4888	    inventory: SemanticInventory | None = None,
  4889	) -> None:
  4890	    """Close the machine-adjudication protocol over proofs and comparisons.
  4886	def _check_machine_adjudication(
  4887	    asserted: Graph,
  4888	    inventory: SemanticInventory | None = None,
  4889	) -> None:
  4890	    """Close the machine-adjudication protocol over proofs and comparisons.
  4891	
  4892	    Everything here spans several records, which is why none of it is SHACL:
  4893	    per-property constraints reach one node, and every rule below relates a
  4894	    comparison to the proofs citing it, to the artifacts they read, and to the
  4895	    assertion it licensed.
  4896	
  4897	    LICENSING IS THE AXIS EVERYTHING TURNS ON. A comparison whose
  4898	    ``rkaf:comparisonOutcome`` is ``rkaf:comparisonSatisfied`` and whose cited
  4899	    proofs all passed their gate LICENSES the mapping it names. Any other
  4900	    outcome is an audit record: the comparison was run, it did not license
  4901	    anything, and publishing it is how a consumer tells "checked, nothing
  4902	    found" from "never checked" -- the distinction rulespec keeps five outcome
  4903	    values to preserve. Structural rules below hold for every comparison;
  4904	    independence and the lattice are asked only of a comparison that licenses,
  4905	    because they exist to protect a claim and a refusal makes none.
  4906	
  4907	    The five normative rules Atlas 1.0's README carried in prose, restated over
  4908	    rkaf's records:
  4909	
  4910	    * **Independence.** At least one PAIR of cited proofs must answer the
  4911	      identical sealed question while differing on all five axes. A single
  4912	      proof, or a set that collapses onto one axis, is one opinion wearing a
  4913	      proof record. This is rulespec's
  4914	      ``rkaf:MachineAdjudicationIndependentPairShape``, widened from its four
  4915	      axes to the five ``spec/rkaf-refspec.md`` states -- and it is "at least
  4916	      one pair", never "exactly two", so three corroborating machines are valid.
  4917	    * **One sealed question.** Every cited proof must read the same sealed
  4918	      request artifact. Two machines answering two questions are not a
  4919	      corroboration of one (v1: "both validations resolve the same
  4920	      atlas:requestArtifact").
  4921	    * **Complete support.** Every proof record in the dataset must be cited by
  4922	      the comparison it was issued for. This is strictly stronger than
  4923	      rulespec's ``rkaf:MachineAdjudicationCompleteSupportShape``, which only
  4924	      catches a dropped proof that shares a sealed request with a kept one:
  4925	      Atlas pins one comparison to one question, so ANY uncited proof is a
  4926	      discarded corroborator. It replaces v1's ``atlas:qualifiedBy``.
  4927	    * **Everything resolves to bundled bytes.** The two compared endpoints, the
  4928	      sealed request, and every sealed response are ``rkaf:Artifact`` records
  4929	      in the distribution; a proof's ``rkaf:sealedRequestDigest`` must equal the
  4930	      content digest of the request artifact it names, its
  4931	      ``rkaf:proofInputDigest`` must pin every input it read, its lineage's
  4932	      ``rkaf:inputContextHash`` must be that same sealed request, and the
  4933	      endpoint artifacts must carry the recorded content of the two resources
  4934	      under comparison. This is v1's ``atlas:inputContextArtifact`` /
  4935	      ``atlas:inputContextDigest`` rule, and v1 gave the reason it cannot be
  4936	      dropped: without it every record can agree on a digest whose bytes exist
  4937	      nowhere. The snapshot chain is the same idea in time -- a proof reads the
  4938	      comparison's snapshot, and that snapshot is the release the mapping
  4939	      targets, so a proof run against an older release cannot license a mapping
  4940	      into a newer one.
  4941	    * **The lattice.** The relation the complete verdict set licenses must be
  4942	      the relation the mapping states.
  4943	    """
  4944	
  4945	    comparisons = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.RelationComparisonContext, inventory)
  4946	    proofs = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.ResolverProofRecord, inventory)
  4947	    issuers = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.ResolverProofIssuer, inventory)
  4948	    lineages = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.AILineage, inventory)
  4949	    artifacts = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.Artifact, inventory)
  4950	    bindings = _carrier_nodes(asserted, RKAF.EvidenceBinding, inventory)
  4951	    # Which assertions owe a licensing proof set. The warrant is the trigger: an
  4952	    # evidence binding declaring aiSuggested + statisticalInference +
  4953	    # reviewedAuthorityChain is claiming two machines adjudicated the mapping,
  4954	    # and until this gate existed nothing made that claim mean anything.
  4955	    adjudicated: set[URIRef] = set()
  4956	    for binding in bindings:
  4957	        if "twoMachineAdjudication" in declared_evidence_warrants(
  4958	            {axis: asserted.value(binding, axis) for axis in EVIDENCE_WARRANT_AXES}
  4959	        ):
  4960	            adjudicated.update(asserted.objects(binding, RKAF.bindsAssertion))
  4961	
  4962	    artifact_facts = _machine_adjudication_artifact_facts(asserted, artifacts)
  4963	    facts = {
  4964	        proof: _machine_adjudication_proof_facts(
  4965	            asserted,
  4966	            proof,
  4967	            issuers=issuers,
  4968	            lineages=lineages,
  4969	            comparisons=comparisons,
  4970	        )
  4971	        for proof in sorted(proofs)
  4972	    }
  4973	
  4974	    cited_by_comparison: dict[URIRef, list[URIRef]] = {}
  4975	    licensing_comparisons: list[URIRef] = []
  4976	    licensed_assertion: dict[URIRef, URIRef] = {}
  4977	    comparison_by_assertion: dict[URIRef, URIRef] = {}
  4978	    for comparison in sorted(comparisons):
  4979	        assertion = _iri(
  4980	            _one(asserted, comparison, RKAF.comparisonExpectedAssertion, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  4981	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  4982	            label="comparisonExpectedAssertion",
  4983	        )
  4984	        if (
  4985	            not inventory.is_assertion(assertion)
  4986	            if inventory is not None
  4987	            else not any(
  4988	                (assertion, RDF.type, assertion_type) in asserted
  4989	                for assertion_type in ASSERTION_TYPES
  4990	            )
  4991	        ):
  4992	            _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{comparison} names unknown assertion {assertion}")
  4993	        if assertion in comparison_by_assertion:
  4994	            _fail(
  4995	                "dataset.adjudication",
  4996	                f"{assertion} is named by two comparisons; one claim answers one "
  4997	                "sealed question",
  4998	            )
  4999	        comparison_by_assertion[assertion] = comparison
  5000	        outcome = _iri(
  5001	            _one(asserted, comparison, RKAF.comparisonOutcome, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  5002	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  5003	            label="comparisonOutcome",
  5004	        )
  5005	        if outcome not in RELATION_COMPARISON_OUTCOMES:
  5006	            _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{comparison} states an unsupported outcome {outcome}")
  5007	        licensing = outcome == RKAF.comparisonSatisfied
  5008	        if licensing:
  5009	            if assertion not in adjudicated:
  5010	                _fail(
  5011	                    "dataset.adjudication",
  5012	                    f"{comparison} licenses {assertion}, whose evidence declares no "
  5013	                    "machine adjudication",
  5014	                )
  5015	            licensing_comparisons.append(comparison)
  5016	            licensed_assertion[comparison] = assertion
  5017	        snapshot = _literal_text(
  5018	            _one(asserted, comparison, RKAF.comparisonSnapshot, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  5019	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  5020	            label="comparisonSnapshot",
  5021	        )
  5022	        target_release = _iri(
  5023	            _one(asserted, assertion, ATLAS.targetRelease, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  5024	            code="dataset.adjudication",
  5025	            label="targetRelease",
  5026	        )
  5027	        if snapshot != str(target_release):
  5028	            _fail(
  5029	                "dataset.adjudication",
  5030	                f"{comparison} read snapshot {snapshot}, which is not the release "
  5031	                f"{assertion} targets",
  5032	            )
  5033	        endpoints = (
  5034	            (
  5035	                RKAF.comparisonBaselineArtifact,
  5036	                _iri(
  5037	                    _one(asserted, assertion, RDF.subject, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  5038	                    code="dataset.adjudication",
  5039	                    label="assertion subject",
  5040	                ),
  5041	            ),
  5042	            (
  5043	                RKAF.comparisonObservedArtifact,
  5044	                _iri(
  5045	                    _one(asserted, assertion, RDF.object, code="dataset.adjudication"),
  5046	                    code="dataset.adjudication",
  5047	                    label="assertion object",
  5048	                ),
  5049	            ),
  5050	        )
  5051	        endpoint_artifacts: set[URIRef] = set()
  5052	        for predicate, endpoint in endpoints:
  5053	            artifact = _iri(
  5054	                _one(asserted, comparison, predicate, code="dataset.adjudication-input"),
  5055	                code="dataset.adjudication-input",
  5056	                label=str(predicate),
  5057	            )
  5058	            if artifact not in artifact_facts:
  5059	                _fail(
  5060	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5061	                    f"{comparison} names {artifact}, which is not a bundled artifact",
  5062	                )
  5063	            if artifact_facts[artifact]["identifiers"] != frozenset({str(endpoint)}):
  5064	                _fail(
  5065	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5066	                    f"{artifact} does not identify {endpoint}, the endpoint "
  5067	                    f"{comparison} claims it captured",
  5068	                )
  5069	            # The endpoint resource no longer publishes its digest, so what the
  5070	            # artifact pins is checked against the endpoint's recomputed facts.
  5071	            recorded = rdf_node_digest(asserted, endpoint)
  5072	            if artifact_facts[artifact]["digest"] != recorded:
  5073	                _fail(
  5074	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5075	                    f"{artifact} pins content {endpoint} does not have",
  5076	                )
  5077	            endpoint_artifacts.add(artifact)
  5078	        cited = sorted(set(asserted.objects(comparison, RKAF.comparisonProofRecord)))
  5079	        request_artifacts: set[URIRef] = set()
  5080	        for proof in cited:
  5081	            if proof not in facts:
  5082	                _fail("dataset.adjudication", f"{comparison} cites unknown proof record {proof}")
  5083	            if facts[proof]["comparison"] != comparison:
  5084	                _fail(
  5085	                    "dataset.adjudication-support",
  5086	                    f"{comparison} cites {proof}, which was issued for "
  5087	                    f"{facts[proof]['comparison']}: a proof replayed against another "
  5088	                    "comparison is a stale pass",
  5089	                )
  5090	            if licensing and facts[proof]["outcome"] != RKAF.gatePass:
  5091	                _fail(
  5092	                    "dataset.adjudication",
  5093	                    f"{comparison} licenses a mapping on {proof}, whose gate returned "
  5094	                    f"{facts[proof]['outcome']}",
  5095	                )
  5096	            if facts[proof]["snapshot"] != snapshot:
  5097	                _fail(
  5098	                    "dataset.adjudication",
  5099	                    f"{proof} read snapshot {facts[proof]['snapshot']}, not the "
  5100	                    f"{snapshot} its comparison did",
  5101	                )
  5102	            inputs = facts[proof]["inputs"]
  5103	            missing = endpoint_artifacts - inputs
  5104	            if missing:
  5105	                _fail(
  5106	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5107	                    f"{proof} did not read {min(missing, key=str)}, an endpoint of the "
  5108	                    "comparison it answers",
  5109	                )
  5110	            requests = inputs - endpoint_artifacts
  5111	            if len(requests) != 1:
  5112	                _fail(
  5113	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5114	                    f"{proof} reads {len(requests)} sealed request artifacts beyond the "
  5115	                    "two compared endpoints; a sealed question is one artifact",
  5116	                )
  5117	            request = next(iter(requests))
  5118	            if request not in artifact_facts:
  5119	                _fail(
  5120	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5121	                    f"{proof} names {request}, which is not a bundled artifact",
  5122	                )
  5123	            if facts[proof]["sealedRequestDigest"] != artifact_facts[request]["digest"]:
  5124	                _fail(
  5125	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5126	                    f"{proof} sealedRequestDigest does not match {request}, the request "
  5127	                    "artifact it read: the sealed question resolves to no bundled bytes",
  5128	                )
  5129	            if facts[proof]["inputContextHash"] != facts[proof]["sealedRequestDigest"]:
  5130	                _fail(
  5131	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5132	                    f"{proof} model lineage ran over an input context that is not the "
  5133	                    "sealed request the proof answers",
  5134	                )
  5135	            expected_digests = frozenset(
  5136	                artifact_facts[value]["digest"]
  5137	                for value in inputs
  5138	                if value in artifact_facts
  5139	            )
  5140	            if facts[proof]["inputDigests"] != expected_digests:
  5141	                _fail(
  5142	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5143	                    f"{proof} proofInputDigest does not pin the exact content of the "
  5144	                    "artifacts it names",
  5145	                )
  5146	            response = facts[proof]["axes"][4]
  5147	            if response not in artifact_facts:
  5148	                _fail(
  5149	                    "dataset.adjudication-input",
  5150	                    f"{proof} sealed response {response} is not a bundled artifact: the "
  5151	                    "verdict resolves to nothing a reviewer can re-read",
  5152	                )
  5153	            request_artifacts.add(request)
  5154	        if len(request_artifacts) > 1:
  5155	            _fail(
  5156	                "dataset.adjudication-independence",
  5157	                f"{comparison} cites proofs answering {len(request_artifacts)} sealed "
  5158	                "questions; two machines answering two questions corroborate nothing",
  5159	            )
  5160	        cited_by_comparison[comparison] = cited
  5161	
  5162	    # Complete support: a proof the dataset carries but no comparison cites is
  5163	    # evidence thrown away after it was produced.
  5164	    for proof in sorted(proofs):
  5165	        comparison = facts[proof]["comparison"]
  5166	        if proof not in cited_by_comparison.get(comparison, ()):
  5167	            _fail(
  5168	                "dataset.adjudication-support",
  5169	                f"{comparison} does not cite {proof}, which was issued for it; a "
  5170	                "mapping cites the complete support set, not the first pair found",
  5171	            )
  5172	
  5173	    for comparison in licensing_comparisons:
  5174	        cited = cited_by_comparison[comparison]
  5175	        witness = next(
  5176	            (
  5177	                pair
  5178	                for pair in combinations(cited, 2)
  5179	                if all(
  5180	                    facts[pair[0]]["axes"][axis] != facts[pair[1]]["axes"][axis]
  5181	                    for axis in range(len(MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_INDEPENDENCE_AXES))
  5182	                )
  5183	            ),
  5184	            None,
  5185	        )
  5186	        if witness is None:
  5187	            collapsed = sorted(
  5188	                {
  5189	                    MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_INDEPENDENCE_AXES[axis]
  5190	                    for first, second in combinations(cited, 2)
  5191	                    for axis in range(len(MACHINE_ADJUDICATION_INDEPENDENCE_AXES))
  5192	                    if facts[first]["axes"][axis] == facts[second]["axes"][axis]
  5193	                }
  5194	            )
  5195	            _fail(
  5196	                "dataset.adjudication-independence",
  5197	                f"{comparison} cites no independent pair of machine adjudications "
  5198	                f"({len(cited)} proof(s); shared: {collapsed or ['no pair exists']})",
  5199	            )
  5200	        assertion = licensed_assertion[comparison]
  5201	        stated = _iri(
  5202	            _one(asserted, assertion, RDF.predicate, code="dataset.adjudication-lattice"),
  5203	            code="dataset.adjudication-lattice",
  5204	            label="assertion predicate",
  5205	        )
  5206	        licensed = _adjudicated_relation({facts[proof]["verdict"] for proof in cited})
  5207	        if licensed is None:
  5208	            _fail(
  5209	                "dataset.adjudication-lattice",
  5210	                f"{comparison} folds its verdicts onto no relation, so {assertion} "
  5211	                "states one the machines did not agree on",
  5212	            )
  5213	        if licensed != stated:
  5214	            _fail(
  5215	                "dataset.adjudication-lattice",
  5216	                f"{assertion} states {stated}, but its verdicts license {licensed}",
  5217	            )
  5218	
  5219	    licensed_assertions = set(licensed_assertion.values())
  5220	    unlicensed = min(
  5221	        (assertion for assertion in adjudicated if assertion not in licensed_assertions),
  5222	        key=str,
  5223	        default=None,
  5224	    )
  5225	    if unlicensed is not None:
  5226	        _fail(
  5227	            "dataset.adjudication",
  5228	            f"{unlicensed} declares a machine-adjudication warrant but no satisfied "
  5229	            "comparison licenses it; the warrant is the protocol's trigger, not a label",
  5230	        )
  5231

  3837	    def qualified_lattice_branches(fixture: Fixture) -> None:
  3838	        """Valid: the three lattice branches the base fixture never reaches.
  3839	
  3840	        The base corpus only ever folds {verdictSame} onto skos:exactMatch, so
  3841	        the closeMatch, narrowMatch and relatedMatch branches could be deleted
  3842	        from the lattice without a single case failing. Each mapping below is
  3843	        adjudicated by two independent machines whose verdicts license exactly
  3844	        the relation it states:
  3845	
  3846	          {same, nearSame}   -> skos:closeMatch    (the weakest claim wins)
  3847	          {targetNarrower}   -> skos:narrowMatch
  3848	          {related}          -> skos:relatedMatch
  3849

  3851	        {subject-a, subject-b, subject-c}, so SKOS S46 and S27 are untouched.
  3852	        """

  3855	        mixed = URIRef("urn:ref:atlas-fixture:resource:mixed-code-subject")
  3856	        subject_c = URIRef("urn:ref:atlas-fixture:resource:subject-c")
  3857	        branches = (
  3858	            ("close", resource, SKOS.closeMatch, mixed,
  3859	             (("alpha", RKAF.verdictSame), ("beta", RKAF.verdictNearSame))),
  3860	            ("narrow", mixed, SKOS.narrowMatch, subject_c,
  3861	             (("alpha", RKAF.verdictTargetNarrower), ("beta", RKAF.verdictTargetNarrower))),
  3862	            ("related", resource, SKOS.relatedMatch, subject_c,
  3863	             (("alpha", RKAF.verdictRelated), ("beta", RKAF.verdictRelated))),
  3864	        )
  3865	        for name, subject, predicate, obj, machines in branches:
  3866	            assertion = _add_assertion(
  3867	                fixture.asserted,
  3868	                assertion_type=ATLAS.MappingAssertion,
  3869	                ring=ATLAS.subject,
  3870	                subject=subject,
  3871	                predicate=predicate,
  3872	                obj=obj,
  3873	                source_release=next(fixture.asserted.objects(subject, ATLAS.inRelease)),
  3874	                target_release=next(fixture.asserted.objects(obj, ATLAS.inRelease)),
  3875	                evidence_record=next(fixture.asserted.objects(subject, ATLAS.sourceRecord)),
  3876	                evidence_name=f"lattice-{name}",
  3877	                review_warrant="twoMachineAdjudication",
  3878	            )
  3879	            _add_adjudication(
  3880	                fixture.asserted,
  3881	                assertion=assertion,
  3882	                name=f"lattice-{name}",
  3883	                machines=machines,
  3884	            )

+import java.util.Locale;
+
+import org.apache.jena.graph.Graph;
+import org.apache.jena.riot.RDFDataMgr;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.ShaclValidator;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.Shapes;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.ValidationReport;
+
+/** Measure Jena data loading, shapes loading, and SHACL validation separately. */
+public final class JenaBenchmark {
+    private static double seconds(long start, long end) {
+        return (end - start) / 1_000_000_000.0;
+    }
+
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        if (args.length != 2) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("usage: JenaBenchmark DATA.nt SHAPES.ttl");
+        }
+
+        long started = System.nanoTime();
+        Graph data = RDFDataMgr.loadGraph(args[0]);
+        long dataLoaded = System.nanoTime();
+        Graph shapesGraph = RDFDataMgr.loadGraph(args[1]);
+        Shapes shapes = ShaclValidator.get().parse(shapesGraph);
+        long shapesLoaded = System.nanoTime();
+        ValidationReport report = ShaclValidator.get().validate(shapes, data);
+        long finished = System.nanoTime();
+
+        System.out.printf(
+            Locale.ROOT,
+            "{\"engine\":\"jena\",\"conforms\":%s,\"results\":%d,"
+                + "\"data_triples\":%d,\"data_load_seconds\":%.9f,"
+                + "\"shapes_load_seconds\":%.9f,\"validation_seconds\":%.9f,"
+                + "\"inside_process_seconds\":%.9f}%n",
+            report.conforms(),
+            report.getEntries().size(),
+            data.size(),
+            seconds(started, dataLoaded),
+            seconds(dataLoaded, shapesLoaded),
+            seconds(shapesLoaded, finished),
+            seconds(started, finished)
+        );
+    }
+}

+def _open_pack(path: Path, compression: str):
+    if compression == "none":
+        return path.open("rb")
+    if compression != "zstd":
+        raise SystemExit(f"unsupported pack compression: {compression}")
+    try:
+        import zstandard
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        raise SystemExit("zstandard is required to read compressed packs") from exc
+    source = path.open("rb")
+    reader = zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(source)
+
+    class _Reader:
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return reader
+
+        def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, traceback):
+            reader.close()
+            source.close()
+
+    return _Reader()
+
+
+def prepare_distribution(distribution: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    manifest = json.loads((distribution / "atlas-manifest.json").read_bytes())
+    asserted = next(row for row in manifest["graphs"] if row["role"] == "asserted")
+    suffix = f" <{asserted['id']}> .\n".encode()
+    count = 0
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with output.open("wb") as destination:
+        for pack in manifest["packs"]:
+            if pack["graphCounts"]["asserted"] == 0:
+                continue
+            path = distribution / pack["path"]
+            compression = pack["transport"]["compression"]
+            with _open_pack(path, compression) as source:
+                for line in source:
+                    if not line.endswith(suffix):
+                        raise SystemExit(
+                            f"{path} contains a line outside asserted graph {asserted['id']}"
+                        )
+                    destination.write(line[: -len(suffix)] + b" .\n")
+                    count += 1
+    if count != asserted["quadCount"]:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"prepared {count} asserted triples; manifest declares {asserted['quadCount']}"
+        )
+    return {
+        "distribution": str(distribution),
+        "distribution_id": manifest["distributionId"],
+        "triples": count,
+        "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def _case_path(case_id: str) -> Path:
+    corpus = json.loads((FIXTURES / "corpus.json").read_bytes())
+    row = next((row for row in corpus["cases"] if row["id"] == case_id), None)
+    if row is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown fixture case: {case_id}")
+    return FIXTURES / row["path"]
+
+
+def extract_shape(shape_name: str, output: Path) -> None:
+    if shape_name not in SHAPE_NAMES:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown prototype shape: {shape_name}")
+    keep = URIRef(PROTO + shape_name)
+    graph = Graph().parse(SHAPES, format="turtle")
+    target_predicates = (
+        SH.targetClass,
+        SH.targetNode,
+        SH.targetSubjectsOf,
+        SH.targetObjectsOf,
+    )
+    kept = 0
+    for predicate in target_predicates:
+        for subject, obj in list(graph.subject_objects(predicate)):
+            if subject == keep:
+                kept += 1
+            else:
+                graph.remove((subject, predicate, obj))
+    if kept == 0:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{shape_name} declares no target")
+    output.write_bytes(graph.serialize(format="turtle", encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _iri(value: str) -> bytes:
+    return f"<{value}>".encode()
+
+
+def _triple(subject: str, predicate: str, obj: str, *, literal: bool = False) -> bytes:
+    object_term = f'"{obj}"'.encode() if literal else _iri(obj)
+    return b" ".join((_iri(subject), _iri(predicate), object_term)) + b" .\n"
+
+
+def augment_staging(source: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Add two independent, lattice-consistent proofs per real mapping.
+
+    The source bytes remain unchanged at the start of the output. Added nodes
+    use a research-only URN namespace and depend only on each real mapping's
+    sorted assertion IRI and stated SKOS predicate.
+    """
+
+    type_pattern = re.compile(
+        rb"^<([^>]*)> <" + re.escape(RDF_TYPE.encode()) + rb"> <"
+        + re.escape(ATLAS_MAPPING.encode()) + rb"> \.\n$"
+    )
+    predicate_pattern = re.compile(
+        rb"^<([^>]*)> <" + re.escape(RDF_PREDICATE.encode()) + rb"> <([^>]*)> \.\n$"
+    )
+    mappings: set[str] = set()
+    predicates: dict[str, str] = {}
+    with source.open("rb") as stream:
+        for line in stream:
+            if match := type_pattern.match(line):
+                mappings.add(match.group(1).decode())
+            elif match := predicate_pattern.match(line):
+                predicates[match.group(1).decode()] = match.group(2).decode()
+
+    verdicts = {
+        SKOS + "exactMatch": RKAF + "verdictSame",
+        SKOS + "closeMatch": RKAF + "verdictNearSame",
+        SKOS + "broadMatch": RKAF + "verdictTargetBroader",
+        SKOS + "narrowMatch": RKAF + "verdictTargetNarrower",
+        SKOS + "relatedMatch": RKAF + "verdictRelated",
+    }
+    missing = sorted(mapping for mapping in mappings if predicates.get(mapping) not in verdicts)
+    if missing:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{len(missing)} mappings lack a licensed SKOS predicate")
+
+    added = 0
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with source.open("rb") as input_stream, output.open("wb") as destination:
+        shutil.copyfileobj(input_stream, destination, length=1 << 22)
+        for index, assertion in enumerate(sorted(mappings)):
+            stem = f"urn:ref:shacl-sparql-benchmark:{index:04d}"
+            comparison = stem + ":comparison"
+            destination.write(_triple(comparison, RDF_TYPE, RKAF + "RelationComparisonContext"))
+            destination.write(
+                _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonOutcome", RKAF + "comparisonSatisfied")
+            )
+            destination.write(
+                _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonExpectedAssertion", assertion)
+            )
+            added += 3
+            for key in ("alpha", "beta"):
+                proof = f"{stem}:proof:{key}"
+                issuer = f"{stem}:issuer:{key}"
+                lineage = f"{stem}:lineage:{key}"
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonProofRecord", proof)
+                )
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RDF_TYPE, RKAF + "ResolverProofRecord"))
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "proofComparisonContext", comparison))
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "proofIssuer", issuer))
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "independenceGroup", f"{stem}:group:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "hasAILineage", lineage))
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "sealedResponseArtifact", f"{stem}:response:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "adjudicationVerdict", verdicts[predicates[assertion]])
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(issuer, RKAF + "proofResolver", f"{stem}:provider:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(lineage, RKAF + "modelId", f"benchmark-model-{key}", literal=True)
+                )
+                added += 10
+
+    with source.open("rb") as input_stream:
+        base_triples = sum(1 for _ in input_stream)
+    with output.open("rb") as output_stream:
+        total_triples = sum(1 for _ in output_stream)
+    return {
+        "base_triples": base_triples,
+        "mapping_assertions": len(mappings),
+        "added_triples": added,
+        "total_triples": total_triples,
+        "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def _report_facts(graph: Graph) -> tuple[bool, int]:
+    reports = list(graph.subjects(RDF.type, SH.ValidationReport))
+    if len(reports) != 1:
+        raise SystemExit(f"expected one SHACL report, found {len(reports)}")
+    conforms = graph.value(reports[0], SH.conforms)
+    results = len(set(graph.subjects(RDF.type, SH.ValidationResult)))
+    return bool(conforms.toPython()), results
+
+
+def pyshacl_validate(data_path: Path, shapes_path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    from pyshacl import validate as shacl_validate
+
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    data = Graph()
+    data.parse(data_path, format="nt")
+    data_loaded = time.perf_counter()
+    shapes = Graph()
+    shapes.parse(shapes_path, format="turtle")
+    shapes_loaded = time.perf_counter()
+    conforms, report_graph, _ = shacl_validate(
+        data,
+        shacl_graph=shapes,
+        inference="none",
+        inplace=True,
+        advanced=True,
+        abort_on_first=False,
+        allow_infos=False,
+        allow_warnings=False,
+        meta_shacl=False,
+    )
+    finished = time.perf_counter()
+    _, results = _report_facts(report_graph)
+    return {
+        "engine": "pyshacl",
+        "conforms": bool(conforms),
+        "results": results,
+        "data_triples": len(data),
+        "data_load_seconds": data_loaded - started,
+        "shapes_load_seconds": shapes_loaded - data_loaded,
+        "validation_seconds": finished - shapes_loaded,
+        "inside_process_seconds": finished - started,
+    }
+
+
+def jena_validate(data_path: Path, shapes_path: Path, jena: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    environment = dict(os.environ)
+    environment["JVM_ARGS"] = "-Xmx4g"
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    process = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            str(jena),
+            "shacl",
+            "validate",
+            "--shapes",
+            str(shapes_path),
+            "--data",
+            str(data_path),
+        ],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        env=environment,
+    )
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+    report = Graph().parse(data=process.stdout.decode(), format="turtle")
+    conforms, results = _report_facts(report)
+    return {
+        "engine": "jena",
+        "conforms": conforms,
+        "results": results,
+        "wall_seconds": elapsed,
+    }
+
+
+def fixture_matrix(jena: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="refspec-shacl-sparql-") as directory:
+        root = Path(directory)
+        for shape_name in SHAPE_NAMES:
+            subset = root / f"{shape_name}.ttl"
+            extract_shape(shape_name, subset)
+            cases = [(case, False) for case in INVALID_CASES[shape_name]]
+            cases.extend((case, True) for case in VALID_CASES)
+            for case_id, expected_conforms in cases:
+                data = root / f"{case_id}.nt"
+                if not data.exists():
+                    prepare_distribution(_case_path(case_id), data)
+                pyshacl = pyshacl_validate(data, subset)
+                jena_result = jena_validate(data, subset, jena)
+                observed = bool(pyshacl["conforms"] and jena_result["conforms"])
+                engines_agree = pyshacl["conforms"] == jena_result["conforms"]
+                rows.append(
+                    {
+                        "shape": shape_name,
+                        "fixture": case_id,
+                        "expected_conforms": expected_conforms,
+                        "pyshacl_conforms": pyshacl["conforms"],
+                        "pyshacl_results": pyshacl["results"],
+                        "jena_conforms": jena_result["conforms"],
+                        "jena_results": jena_result["results"],
+                        "pass": engines_agree and observed == expected_conforms,
+                    }
+                )
+    return rows
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    prepare = subparsers.add_parser("prepare")
+    prepare.add_argument("distribution", type=Path)
+    prepare.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    case = subparsers.add_parser("prepare-case")
+    case.add_argument("case_id")
+    case.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    extract = subparsers.add_parser("extract-shape")
+    extract.add_argument("shape", choices=SHAPE_NAMES)
+    extract.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    augment = subparsers.add_parser("augment-staging")
+    augment.add_argument("source", type=Path)
+    augment.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    pyshacl = subparsers.add_parser("pyshacl")
+    pyshacl.add_argument("data", type=Path)
+    pyshacl.add_argument("shapes", type=Path)
+
+    matrix = subparsers.add_parser("fixture-matrix")
+    matrix.add_argument("--jena", type=Path, required=True)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = _parser().parse_args(list(argv) if argv is not None else None)
+    if args.command == "prepare":
+        result = prepare_distribution(args.distribution, args.output)
+    elif args.command == "prepare-case":
+        result = prepare_distribution(_case_path(args.case_id), args.output)
+    elif args.command == "extract-shape":
+        extract_shape(args.shape, args.output)
+        result = {"shape": args.shape, "output": str(args.output)}
+    elif args.command == "augment-staging":
+        result = augment_staging(args.source, args.output)
+    elif args.command == "pyshacl":
+        result = pyshacl_validate(args.data, args.shapes)
+    else:
+        result = fixture_matrix(args.jena)
+    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Run one benchmark command and report exact child wall time and peak RSS."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = _parser().parse_args(list(argv) if argv is not None else None)
+    command = args.command
+    if command and command[0] == "--":
+        command = command[1:]
+    if not command:
+        raise SystemExit("a command is required after --")
+
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    process = subprocess.Popen(
+        command,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    assert process.stdout is not None
+    assert process.stderr is not None
+    stdout = process.stdout.read()
+    stderr = process.stderr.read()
+    _, status, usage = os.wait4(process.pid, 0)
+    finished = time.perf_counter()
+    returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
+
+    if stdout:
+        sys.stdout.write(stdout)
+        if not stdout.endswith("\n"):
+            sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    if stderr:
+        sys.stderr.write(stderr)
+        if not stderr.endswith("\n"):
+            sys.stderr.write("\n")
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "command": command,
+                "returncode": returncode,
+                "wall_seconds": finished - started,
+                # On macOS ru_maxrss is bytes. This experiment ran on macOS;
+                # retain the native value so no cross-platform guess is hidden.
+                "ru_maxrss_native": usage.ru_maxrss,
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+    return returncode
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+@prefix proto: <urn:ref:research:shacl-sparql#> .
+@prefix rdf:   <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
+@prefix sh:    <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
+@prefix skos:  <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
+@prefix rkaf:  <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#> .
+
+# Prototype compiler output for the four cross-record rules in
+# bindings/atlas/3.1/tools/validate.py::_check_machine_adjudication.
+# Every query uses only SPARQL 1.1 and SHACL-SPARQL pre-bound $this.
+
+proto:FiveAxisIndependenceShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "A satisfied comparison must cite a proof pair that differs by actor, independence group, provider, model ID, and response artifact." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this rkaf:comparisonOutcome rkaf:comparisonSatisfied .
+        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
+          $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?leftProof, ?rightProof .
+          FILTER(?leftProof != ?rightProof)
+
+          ?leftProof
+            rkaf:proofIssuer ?leftIssuer ;
+            rkaf:independenceGroup ?leftGroup ;
+            rkaf:hasAILineage ?leftLineage ;
+            rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?leftResponse .
+          ?rightProof
+            rkaf:proofIssuer ?rightIssuer ;
+            rkaf:independenceGroup ?rightGroup ;
+            rkaf:hasAILineage ?rightLineage ;
+            rkaf:sealedResponseArtifact ?rightResponse .
+          ?leftIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?leftProvider .
+          ?rightIssuer rkaf:proofResolver ?rightProvider .
+          ?leftLineage rkaf:modelId ?leftModel .
+          ?rightLineage rkaf:modelId ?rightModel .
+
+          FILTER(
+            ?leftIssuer != ?rightIssuer &&
+            ?leftGroup != ?rightGroup &&
+            ?leftProvider != ?rightProvider &&
+            STR(?leftModel) != STR(?rightModel) &&
+            ?leftResponse != ?rightResponse
+          )
+        }
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:CompleteSupportShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:ResolverProofRecord ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "The comparison for which a proof was issued must cite that proof." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this rkaf:proofComparisonContext ?comparison .
+        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
+          ?comparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        }
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:VerdictLatticeFoldShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:RelationComparisonContext ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "The complete cited verdict set must fold onto the mapping relation stated by the expected assertion." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
+      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT $this
+      WHERE {
+        $this
+          rkaf:comparisonOutcome rkaf:comparisonSatisfied ;
+          rkaf:comparisonExpectedAssertion ?assertion ;
+          rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?proof .
+        ?assertion rdf:predicate ?statedRelation .
+        ?proof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?verdict .
+
+        FILTER(
+          !(
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:exactMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badExactProof .
+                ?badExactProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badExactVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badExactVerdict != rkaf:verdictSame)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:closeMatch &&
+              EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?nearProof .
+                ?nearProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict rkaf:verdictNearSame .
+              } &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badCloseProof .
+                ?badCloseProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badCloseVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badCloseVerdict NOT IN (
+                  rkaf:verdictSame,
+                  rkaf:verdictNearSame
+                ))
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:broadMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badBroadProof .
+                ?badBroadProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badBroadVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badBroadVerdict != rkaf:verdictTargetBroader)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:narrowMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badNarrowProof .
+                ?badNarrowProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badNarrowVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badNarrowVerdict != rkaf:verdictTargetNarrower)
+              }
+            ) ||
+            (
+              ?statedRelation = skos:relatedMatch &&
+              NOT EXISTS {
+                $this rkaf:comparisonProofRecord ?badRelatedProof .
+                ?badRelatedProof rkaf:adjudicationVerdict ?badRelatedVerdict .
+                FILTER(?badRelatedVerdict != rkaf:verdictRelated)
+              }
+            )
+          )
+        )
+      }
+      """
+  ] .
+
+proto:ProofReplayRefusalShape
+  a sh:NodeShape ;
+  sh:targetClass rkaf:ResolverProofRecord ;
+  sh:sparql [
+    a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
+    sh:message "A proof record may be cited by only one comparison." ;
+    sh:select """
+      PREFIX rkaf: <https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#>
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT $this
+      WHERE {
+        ?firstComparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        ?secondComparison rkaf:comparisonProofRecord $this .
+        FILTER(?firstComparison != ?secondComparison)
+      }
+      """
+  ] .

+import java.util.Locale;
+
+import org.apache.jena.graph.Graph;
+import org.apache.jena.riot.RDFDataMgr;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.ShaclValidator;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.Shapes;
+import org.apache.jena.shacl.ValidationReport;
+
+/** Measure Jena data loading, shapes loading, and SHACL validation separately. */
+public final class JenaBenchmark {
+    private static double seconds(long start, long end) {
+        return (end - start) / 1_000_000_000.0;
+    }
+
+    public static void main(String[] args) {
+        if (args.length != 2) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("usage: JenaBenchmark DATA.nt SHAPES.ttl");
+        }
+
+        long started = System.nanoTime();
+        Graph data = RDFDataMgr.loadGraph(args[0]);
+        long dataLoaded = System.nanoTime();
+        Graph shapesGraph = RDFDataMgr.loadGraph(args[1]);
+        Shapes shapes = ShaclValidator.get().parse(shapesGraph);
+        long shapesLoaded = System.nanoTime();
+        ValidationReport report = ShaclValidator.get().validate(shapes, data);
+        long finished = System.nanoTime();
+
+        System.out.printf(
+            Locale.ROOT,
+            "{\"engine\":\"jena\",\"conforms\":%s,\"results\":%d,"
+                + "\"data_triples\":%d,\"data_load_seconds\":%.9f,"
+                + "\"shapes_load_seconds\":%.9f,\"validation_seconds\":%.9f,"
+                + "\"inside_process_seconds\":%.9f}%n",
+            report.conforms(),
+            report.getEntries().size(),
+            data.size(),
+            seconds(started, dataLoaded),
+            seconds(dataLoaded, shapesLoaded),
+            seconds(shapesLoaded, finished),
+            seconds(started, finished)
+        );
+    }
+}

+"""Prepare data and run the SHACL-SPARQL prototype reproducibly.
+
+The harness writes only paths supplied by the caller. Use a temporary
+directory for generated fixture views, staging views, and per-shape files.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rdflib import Graph, URIRef
+from rdflib.namespace import RDF, SH
+
+
+REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+FIXTURES = REPO / "bindings/atlas/3.1/fixtures"
+SHAPES = REPO / "research/shacl-sparql/shapes/adjudication.shacl.ttl"
+PROTO = "urn:ref:research:shacl-sparql#"
+RDF_TYPE = "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type"
+RDF_PREDICATE = "http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#predicate"
+ATLAS_MAPPING = "https://refspec.org/ns/atlas/v3#MappingAssertion"
+RKAF = "https://rulespec.org/ns/v1#"
+SKOS = "http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#"
+
+SHAPE_NAMES = (
+    "FiveAxisIndependenceShape",
+    "CompleteSupportShape",
+    "VerdictLatticeFoldShape",
+    "ProofReplayRefusalShape",
+)
+
+INVALID_CASES = {
+    "FiveAxisIndependenceShape": (
+        "adjudication-single-proof",
+        "adjudication-same-validator-actor",
+        "adjudication-same-independence-group",
+        "adjudication-same-provider",
+        "adjudication-same-provider-model",
+        "adjudication-same-response-artifact",
+    ),
+    "CompleteSupportShape": ("adjudication-discarded-support",),
+    "VerdictLatticeFoldShape": (
+        "adjudication-relation-not-licensed",
+        "adjudication-verdicts-disagree",
+    ),
+    "ProofReplayRefusalShape": ("adjudication-foreign-comparison",),
+}
+
+VALID_CASES = (
+    "all-resource-profiles",
+    "qualified-three-machine-support",
+    "qualified-lattice-branches",
+    "adjudication-refused-comparison-record",
+)
+
+
+def _open_pack(path: Path, compression: str):
+    if compression == "none":
+        return path.open("rb")
+    if compression != "zstd":
+        raise SystemExit(f"unsupported pack compression: {compression}")
+    try:
+        import zstandard
+    except ImportError as exc:
+        raise SystemExit("zstandard is required to read compressed packs") from exc
+    source = path.open("rb")
+    reader = zstandard.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(source)
+
+    class _Reader:
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return reader
+
+        def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, traceback):
+            reader.close()
+            source.close()
+
+    return _Reader()
+
+
+def prepare_distribution(distribution: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    manifest = json.loads((distribution / "atlas-manifest.json").read_bytes())
+    asserted = next(row for row in manifest["graphs"] if row["role"] == "asserted")
+    suffix = f" <{asserted['id']}> .\n".encode()
+    count = 0
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with output.open("wb") as destination:
+        for pack in manifest["packs"]:
+            if pack["graphCounts"]["asserted"] == 0:
+                continue
+            path = distribution / pack["path"]
+            compression = pack["transport"]["compression"]
+            with _open_pack(path, compression) as source:
+                for line in source:
+                    if not line.endswith(suffix):
+                        raise SystemExit(
+                            f"{path} contains a line outside asserted graph {asserted['id']}"
+                        )
+                    destination.write(line[: -len(suffix)] + b" .\n")
+                    count += 1
+    if count != asserted["quadCount"]:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"prepared {count} asserted triples; manifest declares {asserted['quadCount']}"
+        )
+    return {
+        "distribution": str(distribution),
+        "distribution_id": manifest["distributionId"],
+        "triples": count,
+        "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def _case_path(case_id: str) -> Path:
+    corpus = json.loads((FIXTURES / "corpus.json").read_bytes())
+    row = next((row for row in corpus["cases"] if row["id"] == case_id), None)
+    if row is None:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown fixture case: {case_id}")
+    return FIXTURES / row["path"]
+
+
+def extract_shape(shape_name: str, output: Path) -> None:
+    if shape_name not in SHAPE_NAMES:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown prototype shape: {shape_name}")
+    keep = URIRef(PROTO + shape_name)
+    graph = Graph().parse(SHAPES, format="turtle")
+    target_predicates = (
+        SH.targetClass,
+        SH.targetNode,
+        SH.targetSubjectsOf,
+        SH.targetObjectsOf,
+    )
+    kept = 0
+    for predicate in target_predicates:
+        for subject, obj in list(graph.subject_objects(predicate)):
+            if subject == keep:
+                kept += 1
+            else:
+                graph.remove((subject, predicate, obj))
+    if kept == 0:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{shape_name} declares no target")
+    output.write_bytes(graph.serialize(format="turtle", encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _iri(value: str) -> bytes:
+    return f"<{value}>".encode()
+
+
+def _triple(subject: str, predicate: str, obj: str, *, literal: bool = False) -> bytes:
+    object_term = f'"{obj}"'.encode() if literal else _iri(obj)
+    return b" ".join((_iri(subject), _iri(predicate), object_term)) + b" .\n"
+
+
+def augment_staging(source: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Add two independent, lattice-consistent proofs per real mapping.
+
+    The source bytes remain unchanged at the start of the output. Added nodes
+    use a research-only URN namespace and depend only on each real mapping's
+    sorted assertion IRI and stated SKOS predicate.
+    """
+
+    type_pattern = re.compile(
+        rb"^<([^>]*)> <" + re.escape(RDF_TYPE.encode()) + rb"> <"
+        + re.escape(ATLAS_MAPPING.encode()) + rb"> \.\n$"
+    )
+    predicate_pattern = re.compile(
+        rb"^<([^>]*)> <" + re.escape(RDF_PREDICATE.encode()) + rb"> <([^>]*)> \.\n$"
+    )
+    mappings: set[str] = set()
+    predicates: dict[str, str] = {}
+    with source.open("rb") as stream:
+        for line in stream:
+            if match := type_pattern.match(line):
+                mappings.add(match.group(1).decode())
+            elif match := predicate_pattern.match(line):
+                predicates[match.group(1).decode()] = match.group(2).decode()
+
+    verdicts = {
+        SKOS + "exactMatch": RKAF + "verdictSame",
+        SKOS + "closeMatch": RKAF + "verdictNearSame",
+        SKOS + "broadMatch": RKAF + "verdictTargetBroader",
+        SKOS + "narrowMatch": RKAF + "verdictTargetNarrower",
+        SKOS + "relatedMatch": RKAF + "verdictRelated",
+    }
+    missing = sorted(mapping for mapping in mappings if predicates.get(mapping) not in verdicts)
+    if missing:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{len(missing)} mappings lack a licensed SKOS predicate")
+
+    added = 0
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with source.open("rb") as input_stream, output.open("wb") as destination:
+        shutil.copyfileobj(input_stream, destination, length=1 << 22)
+        for index, assertion in enumerate(sorted(mappings)):
+            stem = f"urn:ref:shacl-sparql-benchmark:{index:04d}"
+            comparison = stem + ":comparison"
+            destination.write(_triple(comparison, RDF_TYPE, RKAF + "RelationComparisonContext"))
+            destination.write(
+                _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonOutcome", RKAF + "comparisonSatisfied")
+            )
+            destination.write(
+                _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonExpectedAssertion", assertion)
+            )
+            added += 3
+            for key in ("alpha", "beta"):
+                proof = f"{stem}:proof:{key}"
+                issuer = f"{stem}:issuer:{key}"
+                lineage = f"{stem}:lineage:{key}"
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(comparison, RKAF + "comparisonProofRecord", proof)
+                )
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RDF_TYPE, RKAF + "ResolverProofRecord"))
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "proofComparisonContext", comparison))
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "proofIssuer", issuer))
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "independenceGroup", f"{stem}:group:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(_triple(proof, RKAF + "hasAILineage", lineage))
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "sealedResponseArtifact", f"{stem}:response:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(proof, RKAF + "adjudicationVerdict", verdicts[predicates[assertion]])
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(issuer, RKAF + "proofResolver", f"{stem}:provider:{key}")
+                )
+                destination.write(
+                    _triple(lineage, RKAF + "modelId", f"benchmark-model-{key}", literal=True)
+                )
+                added += 10
+
+    with source.open("rb") as input_stream:
+        base_triples = sum(1 for _ in input_stream)
+    with output.open("rb") as output_stream:
+        total_triples = sum(1 for _ in output_stream)
+    return {
+        "base_triples": base_triples,
+        "mapping_assertions": len(mappings),
+        "added_triples": added,
+        "total_triples": total_triples,
+        "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
+    }
+
+
+def _report_facts(graph: Graph) -> tuple[bool, int]:
+    reports = list(graph.subjects(RDF.type, SH.ValidationReport))
+    if len(reports) != 1:
+        raise SystemExit(f"expected one SHACL report, found {len(reports)}")
+    conforms = graph.value(reports[0], SH.conforms)
+    results = len(set(graph.subjects(RDF.type, SH.ValidationResult)))
+    return bool(conforms.toPython()), results
+
+
+def pyshacl_validate(data_path: Path, shapes_path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    from pyshacl import validate as shacl_validate
+
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    data = Graph()
+    data.parse(data_path, format="nt")
+    data_loaded = time.perf_counter()
+    shapes = Graph()
+    shapes.parse(shapes_path, format="turtle")
+    shapes_loaded = time.perf_counter()
+    conforms, report_graph, _ = shacl_validate(
+        data,
+        shacl_graph=shapes,
+        inference="none",
+        inplace=True,
+        advanced=True,
+        abort_on_first=False,
+        allow_infos=False,
+        allow_warnings=False,
+        meta_shacl=False,
+    )
+    finished = time.perf_counter()
+    _, results = _report_facts(report_graph)
+    return {
+        "engine": "pyshacl",
+        "conforms": bool(conforms),
+        "results": results,
+        "data_triples": len(data),
+        "data_load_seconds": data_loaded - started,
+        "shapes_load_seconds": shapes_loaded - data_loaded,
+        "validation_seconds": finished - shapes_loaded,
+        "inside_process_seconds": finished - started,
+    }
+
+
+def jena_validate(data_path: Path, shapes_path: Path, jena: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    environment = dict(os.environ)
+    environment["JVM_ARGS"] = "-Xmx4g"
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    process = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            str(jena),
+            "shacl",
+            "validate",
+            "--shapes",
+            str(shapes_path),
+            "--data",
+            str(data_path),
+        ],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        env=environment,
+    )
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+    report = Graph().parse(data=process.stdout.decode(), format="turtle")
+    conforms, results = _report_facts(report)
+    return {
+        "engine": "jena",
+        "conforms": conforms,
+        "results": results,
+        "wall_seconds": elapsed,
+    }
+
+
+def fixture_matrix(jena: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="refspec-shacl-sparql-") as directory:
+        root = Path(directory)
+        for shape_name in SHAPE_NAMES:
+            subset = root / f"{shape_name}.ttl"
+            extract_shape(shape_name, subset)
+            cases = [(case, False) for case in INVALID_CASES[shape_name]]
+            cases.extend((case, True) for case in VALID_CASES)
+            for case_id, expected_conforms in cases:
+                data = root / f"{case_id}.nt"
+                if not data.exists():
+                    prepare_distribution(_case_path(case_id), data)
+                pyshacl = pyshacl_validate(data, subset)
+                jena_result = jena_validate(data, subset, jena)
+                observed = bool(pyshacl["conforms"] and jena_result["conforms"])
+                engines_agree = pyshacl["conforms"] == jena_result["conforms"]
+                rows.append(
+                    {
+                        "shape": shape_name,
+                        "fixture": case_id,
+                        "expected_conforms": expected_conforms,
+                        "pyshacl_conforms": pyshacl["conforms"],
+                        "pyshacl_results": pyshacl["results"],
+                        "jena_conforms": jena_result["conforms"],
+                        "jena_results": jena_result["results"],
+                        "pass": engines_agree and observed == expected_conforms,
+                    }
+                )
+    return rows
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    prepare = subparsers.add_parser("prepare")
+    prepare.add_argument("distribution", type=Path)
+    prepare.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    case = subparsers.add_parser("prepare-case")
+    case.add_argument("case_id")
+    case.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    extract = subparsers.add_parser("extract-shape")
+    extract.add_argument("shape", choices=SHAPE_NAMES)
+    extract.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    augment = subparsers.add_parser("augment-staging")
+    augment.add_argument("source", type=Path)
+    augment.add_argument("output", type=Path)
+
+    pyshacl = subparsers.add_parser("pyshacl")
+    pyshacl.add_argument("data", type=Path)
+    pyshacl.add_argument("shapes", type=Path)
+
+    matrix = subparsers.add_parser("fixture-matrix")
+    matrix.add_argument("--jena", type=Path, required=True)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = _parser().parse_args(list(argv) if argv is not None else None)
+    if args.command == "prepare":
+        result = prepare_distribution(args.distribution, args.output)
+    elif args.command == "prepare-case":
+        result = prepare_distribution(_case_path(args.case_id), args.output)
+    elif args.command == "extract-shape":
+        extract_shape(args.shape, args.output)
+        result = {"shape": args.shape, "output": str(args.output)}
+    elif args.command == "augment-staging":
+        result = augment_staging(args.source, args.output)
+    elif args.command == "pyshacl":
+        result = pyshacl_validate(args.data, args.shapes)
+    else:
+        result = fixture_matrix(args.jena)
+    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
